_readme: Commands the hooks run per project. 'auto' detects from ROOT-LEVEL project files only (pyproject.toml -> ruff/pytest, package.json -> npm scripts/tsc/prettier) — monorepos need explicit commands with per-step 'cwd'. /create-rules replaces 'auto' with explicit commands during setup — keep them in sync with CLAUDE.md's Validation section. Set 'off' (or []) to disable a hook. Steps accept optional 'ok_returncodes' (e.g. [0, 5] for pytest's no-tests-collected). notify: 'fail' (macOS notification when the Stop gate blocks, plus when the auto-reflector finishes a draft) | 'all' (also on green turn-end) | 'off' (silence everything, reflector drafts included).
_project_note: Shadowing Plus has NO root package.json — all app code and tooling live in web/. Commands are pinned explicitly with cwd:'web' because 'auto' only inspects root-level files and would silently disable these gates. lint=eslint (flat config), tests=vitest (postprocess + SRS pure fns). No prettier installed, so post_edit is lint-only. tsc is available but omitted from the Stop gate to keep it fast; run `npm run build` via /validate for the full type+build gauntlet.

post_edit._lint_note: --no-install pins to the project's eslint (v9). Bare `npx eslint` fetches the latest (v10), which crashes on eslint-plugin-react's version detection (react/display-name: getFilename is not a function) and false-alarms every .ts/.tsx edit. Keep --no-install so the hook uses web/node_modules and fails loudly if eslint is missing instead of silently pulling v10.
